feat: add rolling-window weather scenarios and out-of-time holdout split

Adds a rolling-window weather scenario stage alongside the instant one,
enables lightgbm/random_forest/logistic_regression training, and raises
random search iterations to 50.

Introduces an out-of-time hold-out: merge_data_files stamps a year column
onto every row, and split_dataset carves the most recent year into a
separate holdout parquet (dropping the year column) so reported metrics
reflect predicting a genuinely future year instead of leaking temporally
adjacent rows across a random split.

fix: suppress Pillow DeprecationWarning from matplotlib PDF backend

The matplotlib PDF backend triggers a noisy Pillow API deprecation warning
('mode' parameter is deprecated) when saving PDF files. This warning is not
actionable for us—it's a known issue in matplotlib's code that the library
hasn't yet updated.

Suppress this specific DeprecationWarning narrowly around the PDF savefig
call using a context manager, following the existing pattern in this file
for suppressing known-noisy third-party warnings (resource_tracker).

Fixes: PDF-save test warning with -W default flag.

fix: clip skewed weather features to 0 before log1p to avoid -inf

Raw FMI data uses negative sentinels (e.g. -1) in Precipitation/Snow
depth columns for "not applicable" readings. log1p(-1) produces -inf,
which crashed RobustScaler.fit with "Input X contains infinity" the
first time this ran against real preprocessed data.

fix: use 0-based offset in month and day-of-week cyclical encoding

Without the -1 offset, the last value (month 12, day 7) maps to sin(2π)=0
which is identical to sin(0), creating a false discontinuity between adjacent
periods (Dec/Jan, Sat/Sun). The -1 offset ensures the cycle runs 0..(n-1)/n
so adjacent values remain close on the unit circle.
